description: This file implements the WSEndpoint class template for WebSocket communication, including connection management, message handling, event loop control, and template instantiations for various configurations.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket server endpoints with connection handling, messaging, and event loop control.

methods.name: WSEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket endpoint, setting up handlers, and starting the server.

methods.name: ~WSEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor stopping the event loop and closing connections.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes an active WebSocket connection if open.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: stopEventLoop
methods.description: Stops the event loop thread if running.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers message, open, close, and fail handlers for WebSocket events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filtering by opcode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection object from a handler.
